what: An 11px dot (transparent .55) 24px to the lower right of the cursor follows with no delay, and when it rests for 150ms over a link, button or labeled card it unfolds into a pill holding words that fit that spot (inner padding 0→8·14px, text 0→14px, .24s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1)) — switching to each card’s accent color or a white-background theme. At the screen edge it flips to the opposite side of the cursor. After 9 seconds of pointing at nothing it shows a bit of self-talk, and on the first visit it shows a greeting at the bottom center of the screen after .7s, then slides to the cursor in .45s on the first movement (it closes 1.4s after scrolling).

options.link: Text over an unlabeled link, default ”Browse”
options.button: Text above an unlabeled button, default ”Tap to try”
options.idleText: Idle mutterings — several separated by 「|」, one is picked. An empty value shows nothing
options.idle: Wait before the self-talk line (ms), default 9000
options.hello: First-visit greeting — several separated by ”|”. Leave empty for no greeting (once per session)
options.intent: Delay from pointing to speaking (ms), default 150
options.offset: Distance away from the cursor (px), default 24
options.min: Not applied on screens narrower than this width (px), default 768
options.[data-fx-part=quip]: Cards · photos to assign a word to (optional) — the word goes in data-label, the theme accent·paper in data-key
options.--fx-quip-bg·--fx-quip-ink·--fx-quip-acc: Idle dot · default pill background and text, accent theme background (CSS variables). Default --kf-accent · --kf-ink

use: <body data-fx="cursor-quip" data-fx-cursor-quip="hello: Welcome|Take your time; idleText: Are you still there?"> … <a data-fx-part="quip" data-label="View work" data-key="accent">
note: Not applied on touch devices or below 768px (same as the original). One pill is created inside the attached element (body if body). The original mixes in a joke 40% of the time per line, up to 6 times per session — here only one set of lines is accepted, so that mixing is dropped.
